cards.title: What is poverty?
cards.text: Poverty is not having enough money for basics like food, shelter, health and education.

cards.title: Causes of poverty
cards.text: Low incomes, no jobs, little education, illness and big families without support can trap people in poverty.

qs.q: A major cause of poverty is…

cards.title: Inflation
cards.text: Inflation is a general rise in prices. Your money buys less than before.

cards.title: Who suffers from inflation
cards.text: Poor families spend most of their income on food, so price rises hit them hardest.

cards.title: Causes of inflation
cards.text: Too much demand, high fuel costs, supply shortages or bad harvests can push prices up.

cards.title: Income inequality
cards.text: Inequality means a small group holds a big share of wealth. It limits opportunity for others.

cards.title: Reducing poverty
cards.text: Jobs, education, healthcare, skills and fair wages lift people out of poverty for good.

qs.q: A lasting way to reduce poverty is…

cards.title: Free vs earned help
cards.text: Free help is vital in crisis, but skills and jobs give lasting independence.

cards.title: Savings habit
cards.text: Saving a part of income protects against emergencies and builds future security.

cards.title: Food security
cards.text: Food security means everyone can always get enough safe, nutritious food.

cards.title: Middle class role
cards.text: A growing middle class spends, saves and invests, driving demand and stability.

cards.title: Taxes
cards.text: Taxes fund roads, schools, hospitals and defence. Fair taxes help share the cost.

cards.title: Why jobs matter
cards.text: Jobs give income, dignity and purpose. Unemployment wastes talent and causes stress.

options: Lack of jobs for those seeking work

cards.title: Entrepreneurship
cards.text: An entrepreneur starts a business, takes risks and creates jobs for others.

cards.title: Startups
cards.text: Startups use new ideas and technology to solve problems, and can grow quickly.

cards.title: Skill development
cards.text: Teaching practical skills prepares youth for jobs that employers actually need.

cards.title: Small businesses
cards.text: Small shops and workshops employ millions and keep local economies running.

cards.title: GDP
cards.text: GDP is the total value of goods and services a country produces in a year. It is a measure of the size of an economy.

cards.title: Growth vs development
cards.text: Growth means more output. Development also includes health, education and fairness.

cards.title: Agriculture
cards.text: Many Indians depend on farming. Better irrigation, fair prices and storage lift farmer incomes.

cards.title: Informal work
cards.text: Many people work without contracts or benefits. Formal jobs offer security.

cards.title: Gig economy
cards.text: Gig workers do short tasks through apps, with flexibility but often little security.

cards.title: Women in work
cards.text: More women in the workforce would grow the economy, but safety and childcare matter.

cards.title: Brain drain
cards.text: Brain drain is when skilled people leave their country for better chances abroad.

cards.title: Developing country
cards.text: A developing country is working to raise incomes, health and education for its people.

cards.title: Exports and imports
cards.text: Exports are goods sold abroad; imports are goods bought from abroad.

cards.title: Globalisation
cards.text: Globalisation links countries through trade, travel and ideas. It brings choice but also competition.

cards.title: Make in India
cards.text: Making goods at home creates jobs and reduces dependence on imports.

cards.title: Infrastructure
cards.text: Roads, ports, power and internet lower costs and connect people to markets.

cards.title: Digital economy
cards.text: Online payments and e-commerce make trade easier and widen access to markets.

cards.title: Demographic dividend
cards.text: A large young population can power growth if they are educated and employed.

cards.title: Global slowdown
cards.text: When major economies slow down, trade and jobs everywhere can suffer.

cards.title: Debt
cards.text: Borrowing can fund growth, but too much debt makes repayment a burden.

cards.title: Sustainable growth
cards.text: Growth should not use up resources so quickly that future generations are left poor.

cards.title: Corruption and growth
cards.text: Corruption wastes public money and scares away investment.

cards.title: Fair trade
cards.text: Fair trade means producers get a just price, supporting poor farmers and workers.
